Security Model

Organization-Wide Defaults

A Salesforce object’s visibility is controlled at the top level by the security model of visibility defined for the object.

The object visibility may be:

  • Public Read Only
  • Public Read/Write
  • Private
  • Controlled By Parent

Sharing Rules

Salesforce records can be shared in the following ways:

  • Criteria-Based Sharing Rules
  • Owner-Based Sharing Rules
  • Apex Managed Sharing Rules

A private object can be shared from a public group; a role; a role and all its subordinates to a public group; a role; and / or a role and all its subordinates.
